Construction Inspector
Moon Township, PA, United States

Michael Baker International’s Construction Services staff supports clients by acting as their trusted on-site agent through all phases of construction, from pre-design to close-out, by providing qualified construction managers, inspectors, constructability reviewers, schedulers, estimators and safety experts. As new technologies evolve throughout the construction industry, innovative ideas are required to maintain and deliver successful construction projects.

Michael Baker International is seeking a Construction Inspector to join our growing team! In this role, you'll work on critical infrastructure projects including water and wastewater treatment facilities, pump stations, pipelines, utility systems, and related improvements that directly impact the communities we serve.

Inspect water and wastewater construction projects, including treatment plants, pump stations, lift stations, force mains, gravity sewer systems, and water distribution pipelines.
Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with project plans, specifications, permits, safety requirements, and industry standards.
Review and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents.
Document daily construction activities through detailed reports, photos, field notes, and project records.
Verify that materials, equipment, workmanship, and construction practices meet quality and performance requirements.
Observe and document testing activities, including hydrostatic testing, pressure testing, startup and commissioning, and system performance verification.
Track quantities, review field measurements, and assist with project documentation and contract administration.
Represent the client in the field and serve as a trusted liaison among project stakeholders.
Partner closely with Construction Managers and project teams to support successful project delivery.

High School Diploma or GED required;
3+ years of construction inspection experience with water/wastewater projects
Ability to stand for long periods of time and navigate physically demanding construction sites
Familiarity with treatment plants, distribution/collection systems, or utility infrastructure
Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and inspection procedures
Experience reading and interpreting plans and specifications
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites
Strong communication and documentation skills

The approximate compensation range for this position is $27/hr - $45/hr. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

Medical, dental, vision insurance
401k Retirement Plan
Health Savings Account (HSA)
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability
Professional and personal development
Generous paid time off

Michael Baker International, a leading provider of engineering and consulting services, including design, planning, architectural, environmental, construction and program management, has been solving some of the world’s most complex infrastructure challenges for more than 85 years with a legacy of expertise, experience, innovation and integrity.

Based in Pittsburgh and with over 100 offices nationwide, we partner with clients on everything from roads, bridges, tunnels, mass transit, and airports, to water treatment plants, arctic oil pipelines, environmental restoration and specialized overseas construction. We serve as a trusted adviser to the communities we serve, making them safer, more accessible, more sustainable and more prosperous.

We provide visionary leadership in facilitating transformational change for our clients. Our work delivers differentiating innovations and dedicated experts who challenge the status quo and share a world of diverse experience and an impassioned entrepreneurial spirit. We deliver quality of life.
